info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Products Management API
info.description: The Loan Products Management API enables businesses to create and manage various loan product offerings efficiently. This API allows users to submit new loan product details, ensuring flexibility in adapting to market needs. Ideal for financial institutions and lending platforms, the API streamlines the process of adding customized loan products for different customer segments. This enhances the overall service portfolio and enables better engagement with clients seeking tailored lending solutions.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new loan product in the system. You need to provide the necessary details for the loan product in the request body. Upon successful creation, the loan product will be available for further operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new loan product. It contains all the necessary attributes required to define the loan product and its specifications.
